task: Write a Python function save_report(path, text) that writes the given text to the given path, and a load_report(path) that reads it back.

constraints.text: all text file I/O passes encoding='utf-8' explicitly
constraints.why: the Windows cp1252 default corrupted exported data files twice this year

checks.description: open() call without an explicit encoding
utf-8 is never named as the encoding

constraints.text: decoding failures surface as exceptions; error-swallowing modes like errors='ignore' stay out of the codebase
constraints.why: errors='ignore' silently dropped customer names with accents from the June export

checks.description: suppresses decode errors with errors='ignore' or 'replace'
